اعتملت (form VIII)
# اِعْتَمَلْتُ (iʕtamaltu) /iʕ.ta.mal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِعْتَمَلَ (iʕtamala)
# اِعْتَمَلْتَ (iʕtamalta) /iʕ.ta.mal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِعْتَمَلَ (iʕtamala)
# اِعْتَمَلْتِ (iʕtamalti) /iʕ.ta.mal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِعْتَمَلَ (iʕtamala)
# اِعْتَمَلَتْ (iʕtamalat) /iʕ.ta.ma.lat/: third-perso
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
